name: Name
forbidden: You do not have permission to view the event catalog.
read_only: This event contract is managed by its source and is read-only here.
contract_help: Use custom. followed by lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; dots separate nonempty segments.
save_error: The event could not be saved. Check its identity and schema, then retry.
catalog_error: The event catalog could not be loaded. Retry with Refresh.
runtime_error: The runtime snapshot could not be loaded. Retry with Refresh.
ephemeral: Current host instance only. Events, queues and activity are held in memory and may be lost on restart; configuration is persistent.
consumed_help: Consumed means a delivery was dequeued and handed to its consumer. It does not indicate workflow success or failure. Viewing this page does not consume events.
queue_counters_help: Queue counters cover the current subscription membership lifetime; they do not share the activity window and must not be added to window totals.
accepts_all: This schema accepts every payload. Its policy is preserved when saving.
rejects_all: This schema rejects every payload. Its policy is preserved when saving.
schema_undeclared: This source has not declared a payload schema.
workflow_reason_unavailable: The subscription cannot currently accept new events. Check its application configuration and permissions.
workflow_refresh_error: Workflow subscriptions could not be refreshed. Retry with Refresh.
reason_event_unavailable: The event is missing or disabled.
reason_phase_unavailable: The selected trigger phase is unavailable.
reason_input_mapping: The workflow input mapping is invalid.
reason_application_unpublished: The application has no available publication.
reason_compiled_plan: The published execution plan is unavailable.
reason_trigger_type: The application is not an event workflow.
reason_workspace_unavailable: Workspace access is unavailable or has changed.
reason_runtime_unconfigured: No runtime resource policy is configured.
reason_resource_exhausted: The runtime resource budget is insufficient.
reason_receiver_failed: The event receiver stopped after an error.
reason_refresh_unavailable: The subscription configuration could not be refreshed.
reason_snapshot_changed: Subscription configuration changed; existing deliveries are draining.
reason_not_authenticated: Authentication is required to activate the subscription.
reason_component_export: A required component export is invalid.
reason_state_transition: The current state prevents subscription activation.
loss_window_help: Counts cover observation records lost in this workspace during the current accounting window, not failed event consumption. They restart when the window ends or its accounting record is evicted.
loss_unavailable: No observation loss accounting window is available. This does not establish that no records were lost.
